sources.document_title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics SPECIFICATION (Reference Sheet) for CL31A226KAHNNNE, Multi-layer Ceramic Capacitor, with appended MLCC Product Manual
sources.locator: Page 1 title block (Supplier, Samsung P/N, Product, Description), Section A Samsung Part Number decode table and Section B Structure & Dimension table
sources.evidence_extract: Supplier: Samsung electro-mechanics; Samsung P/N: CL31A226KAHNNNE; Product: Multi-layer Ceramic Capacitor; Description: CAP, 22uF, 25V, +/-10%, X5R, 1206. Decode: CL series; size 1206 (inch code) L 3.20+/-0.20 mm, W 1.60+/-0.20 mm; dielectric X5R; capacitance 22uF; tolerance +/-10%; rated voltage 25V; thickness 1.60+/-0.20 mm; inner electrode Ni, termination Cu, plating Ni/Sn 100%; product Normal; packaging Embossed Type, 7 inch reel, 2K. Section B shows a two-terminal block with end terminations (BW). Hash comparison: A5 baseline: none. A5 recorded no datasheet URL or SHA-256 for C12891 (engineering/a5/passive_evidence/C12891.snapshot.json carries no dataManualUrl/dataManualOfficialLink and engineering/a5/electronics/source_provenance.json has no entry), so there is no A5 hash to compare; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08, HTTP 200, Content-Type application/download, 3029554 bytes, starts %PDF-, 38 pages; GET and the product page's POST form return identical bytes): 494f80f330a87c3824749772750a3a781eb2838f9eb5766439eb7c6f30b9ffb8 - no A5 baseline.

sources.document_title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics SPECIFICATION (Reference Sheet) for CL31A226KAHNNNE, Multi-layer Ceramic Capacitor, with appended MLCC Product Manual
sources.locator: Section C Samsung Reliability Test and Judgement Condition table, rows Capacitance, Withstanding Voltage and Temperature Characteristics
sources.evidence_extract: Capacitance: within specified tolerance at 1kHz+/-10%, 1.0+/-0.2Vrms. Withstanding Voltage: no breakdown at 250% of the rated voltage. Temperature Characteristics X5R: from -55C to 85C capacitance change within +/-15%. Hash comparison: A5 baseline: none. A5 recorded no datasheet URL or SHA-256 for C12891 (engineering/a5/passive_evidence/C12891.snapshot.json carries no dataManualUrl/dataManualOfficialLink and engineering/a5/electronics/source_provenance.json has no entry), so there is no A5 hash to compare; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08, HTTP 200, Content-Type application/download, 3029554 bytes, starts %PDF-, 38 pages; GET and the product page's POST form return identical bytes): 494f80f330a87c3824749772750a3a781eb2838f9eb5766439eb7c6f30b9ffb8 - no A5 baseline. The High Temperature Resistance and Temperature Cycling rows use 'Max. operating temperature' and 'Min. operating temperature' as test conditions without printing a number; the only numeric temperature span on the sheet is the X5R row (-55 C to 85 C). Row added 2026-11-11 from bytes re-downloaded by the cloud VM (HTTP 200, application/pdf) whose SHA-256 is identical to this record's; text layer read with pdftotext -layout on that page.
